sampling: Body paragraphs counted from the TL;DR paragraph (headings, images and front matter excluded; the display equation and the table each count as one block); started at paragraph 2 and took every third: L20, L28, L38, L46, L56, L73, L83.

score_notes.A: Front matter complete (subtitle, paper_author, paper_doi, two-level categories, use_math with math); $$-only math; no body H1. Deduction: every H2 is a topic name (L18 '## 연구 배경', L24 '## 제안 방법', L44 '## 구현 방식', L52 '## 실험 결과', L85 '## 의의와 한계'), acceptable for the fixed 5-section summary but not claim headings; L79 '### 랭크와 부분공간 분석' is a topic heading too.
score_notes.B: Mostly natural '입니다' prose. Deductions: L20 '미세조정이 훨씬 낫다는 점을 보여 줍니다' (noun frame; rewrite '부록의 실험에서는 GPT-3도 미세조정이 퓨샷 학습보다 훨씬 낫습니다'); L83 '과제 특화 특징을 키운다는 "시사"로 제시한 해석입니다' (awkward frame; rewrite '논문은 이를 과제에 필요한 특징을 증폭할 수 있다는 정도로만 시사합니다'); L20 '퓨 샷' spacing; inconsistent naming PreEmbed (L62, L73) vs PrefixEmbed (L73, L87) in the same post.
score_notes.C: Clear arc from deployment cost to latency trade-off to method to results; concepts introduced before use (4.7M budget defined L50 before L69). Minor: L73 jumps from the scatter plot to the low-data MNLI-100 result without a transition.
score_notes.D: Good help on the hard part of the method (zero-init of B, alpha/r rationale L34, worked parameter count L38). Under-explained: L83 '정규화 유사도 0.5 이상' never says what the similarity measures (Grassmann-based phi in [0,1]); the projection U^T W V^T behind 0.32/21.67/0.02 is only sketched, and this is the hardest passage.
score_notes.E: Table L58-67 matches the paper's GPT-3 table cell for cell (verified all 8 rows); two figures referred to descriptively ('위 구조도', '이 산점도'). Deduction: GLUE/E2E comparisons at L77 are a dense number list in prose where a short table would read faster; image files are not in the eval output so their presence could not be checked.
score_notes.F: All 15 sampled claims and extra spot checks (latency table, memory/throughput, LR 2E-04, LoRA+PE 75.0-76.2, Table 5/6 cells) are supported. Minor deductions: L48 puts '32.5 → 43.1 tokens/s' and '약 25% 빨라졌습니다' in one clause, but that throughput rise is +32.6%; the paper's 25% is its own speedup statement and the post does not reconcile them. L89 lists '랭크 분석은 주로 ... 48번째 층 중심' as a limitation although the paper says the conclusion holds for other layers (Section H.1). L34 drops the paper's condition 'if we scale the initialization appropriately' and L40 drops 'training all biases'.
score_notes.U1: Motivation (L20-22), solution (L26-42), implementation (L46-50), results (L54-83), significance/limits (L87-89) all covered; a reader learns what, how and why without the paper.
score_notes.U2: About 5,200 non-space characters, roughly a five-minute read; TL;DR is plain prose without math (L16) but one long paragraph rather than 2-3 short lines; one distilled results table; grounded limitations (L89). Slight padding in L48 storage arithmetic.
score_notes.X1: Category 'Finetuning' plausible. Tags are too many and not reusable: 'Low-Rank-Adaptation' restates the title, 'Frozen-Pre-trained-Weights', 'Adapter-Inference-Latency', 'Rank-Decomposition-Matrices' are phrases from the abstract rather than short reusable tags.
score_notes.G: use_math true with $$ present; description is 138 characters, plain text, opens with 'LoRA는', numbers (10,000배, 3배) all in the TL;DR; no Liquid, no prompt tokens. Not run through the blog lint here.

claim_headings.evidence: All H2s are topic names (L18, L24, L44, L52, L85); only L75 '### 작은 모델에서의 일관성' states a claim.

running_example.evidence: GPT-3 175B with W_q/W_v at r=4 recurs (L38 98,304 params, L48 35MB checkpoint, L81, L83 r=4 projection) but is not set up explicitly as the running example.

mechanism_choice_formula_example.evidence: L26 hypothesis -> L28-32 formula -> L34 init/scaling choice with reason -> L38 worked count -> L40 comparison with adapters/prefix.

facts_once.evidence: No inference latency stated at L16, L40, L42 and L87; MNLI-m 89.5->91.7 repeated in L69 after the table.

numbers_with_scope.evidence: Numbers carry model, variant and setting (L22 'GPT-2 medium, 배치 1, 시퀀스 길이 128', L77 parameter counts per row); one ambiguous relative figure at L48 ('약 25%').

nothing_invented.evidence: The only non-paper arithmetic (L38) is flagged '규모 감각을 위해 계산해 보면' and is correct (12,288^2 = 150,994,944; 2x12,288x4 = 98,304).

writer_assessment_at_end.evidence: L87-89 mostly restate the paper's own limitations and open questions (batching after merge, heuristic matrix choice, small r vs other languages, model size vs optimal rank); no 'when to use it' judgment.

length_fitted.evidence: About 5,200 characters for a short method paper; hard parts (method, subspace) get the most space.

type_specific_shape.evidence: Fixed 5-section summary with TL;DR (L14-16), one results table (L58-67), grounded limitations (L89).

korean_style.evidence: Varied sentences and consistent 입니다 register; a few noun frames (L20 '~다는 점을 보여 줍니다', L83 '~다는 "시사"로 제시한 해석입니다').

checklist.note: human_fixes.yaml has fixes: [] for summary-lora. Generic defects from its notes are avoided: no HTML entity leak ('&' absent) and the title is the paper title, not 'Pdf'.

top_issues: Headings are topic names (L18-L85) rather than claim headings, and the closing L87-89 mostly restates the paper's own limitations and open questions instead of the writer's judgment of when to use LoRA.

L48 joins a +32.6% throughput rise (32.5->43.1 tokens/s) with '약 25% 빨라졌습니다' without saying what the 25% measures; L89 calls the 48th-layer focus a limitation although the paper reports the same result for other layers (H.1).
Tags (L10) restate the title and abstract phrases instead of short reusable tags; L83 subspace similarity is used without saying what it measures; PreEmbed/PrefixEmbed naming is inconsistent.
